crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in…
Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’…
By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his…
who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few…
and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought…
Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them…
The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

people.name: Ham
people.line: One of Noah's three sons, father of Canaan.

people.name: Japheth
people.line: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples

people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

people.name: Shem
people.line: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples

translations.web: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—
translations.bsb: On that very day Noah entered the ark, along with his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and his wife, and the three wives of his sons—
translations.kjv: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
